entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: A mystic egg-shaped stone tied to the Meditation Realm, made from a piece of Ugin's essence.

entities.name: Meditation Realm
entities.description: The plane to which the Spirit-Gem is metaphysically tied.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who wore the Spirit-Gem between his horns for millennia.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Bolas's brother, a Spirit Dragon planeswalker who communicates through the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who picked up the Spirit-Gem after Bolas's defeat.

entities.name: Araithia Shokta
entities.description: A person in Caligo to whom Ugin briefly spoke through the Gem.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind-mage who steals the Spirit-Gem.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanied Jace to the Meditation Plane.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker whose special mindset helps clear the others' minds.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who attacks Bolas to distract him.

entities.name: Caligo
entities.description: A place on Dominaria where Ugin spoke through the Gem.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war on Ravnica during which Bolas used the Gem to absorb sparks.

entities.name: Elderspell
entities.description: The spell by which Bolas harvested planeswalkers' sparks.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact Liliana held and gave up.

events.summary: Bolas kills Ugin, finds the Spirit-Gem in the Meditation Realm and claims it, wearing it for millennia.
events.quote: Bolas found the gem in the Meditation Realm after killing his brother Ugin

events.summary: After Bolas's defeat Liliana picks up the Spirit-Gem before planeswalking away.
events.quote: After Bolas's defeat, Liliana Vess picked up the Spirit-Gem before she planeswalked away.

events.summary: Ugin speaks through the Gem to Araithia and appears to Liliana, telling her she must choose her path to redemption.
events.quote: Ugin briefly spoke through the Gem to Araithia Shokta and appeared to Liliana Vess

events.summary: Holding the Gem and the Chain Veil, Liliana sees the Gem glow and disappear; she drops the Veil and the Gem returns to Ugin.
Jace and Vraska reach the Meditation Plane through an Omenpath and meet Narset and Elspeth.
events.quote: they were met by Narset and Elspeth Tirel who had followed a lead to find a solution to the increasing dragonstorms

events.summary: They meet the sealed elder dragons; Ugin berates Jace while the nameless dragon that had been Bolas looks for an opportunity.
events.quote: the nameless dragon that had been Nicol Bolas saw a chance to gain information and regain power.

events.summary: Jace secretly steals the Spirit-Gem from behind Ugin and casts a reality-altering spell.
events.quote: He secretly moved behind Ugin's back and stole the Spirit-Gem.

events.summary: Elspeth attacks Bolas, thinking Jace will offer him the Gem, and Vraska tries to hold Jace back.
events.quote: Thinking that he would offer the Gem to Bolas, Elspeth attacked and temporarily distracted him.

events.summary: Jace's endurance fails and reality breaks into a void that unmakes him; he shatters like glass.
events.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

relations.quote: Bolas found the gem in the Meditation Realm after killing his brother Ugin
Bolas found the gem in the Meditation Realm after killing his brother Ugin
